name: io.github.Mohammed-Jameal-J/newsblog-composer
description: Research, verify and audit news blog posts. Finds corroborated stories, extracts sourced facts, mines keywords, builds NewsArticle and FAQPage schema, and reviews a human-written draft. It does not write the prose.

environmentVariables.name: TAVILY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Search provider; keyless GDELT is used when absent.

environmentVariables.name: GPTZERO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Real AI-detection reading; without it no detection score is reported.

environmentVariables.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Image generation via Workers AI.

environmentVariables.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Image generation via Workers AI.
